title: Web Agents Should Adopt the Compile-and-Execute Paradigm
abstract: arXiv:2605.14290v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: ReAct has become the default architecture across LLM agents, and many existing web agents follow this paradigm. We argue that it is the wrong default for web agents. Instead, web agents should default to compile-and-execute: commit to a task-specific program before observing runtime web content, then execute it. The reason is that web content mixes inputs from many parties. An e-commerce product page may combine a seller's listing, customer reviews, sponsored advertisements, and platform-generated recommendations. Under ReAct, all of this content flows into the model when deciding on the next action, creating a direct path for prompt injections to steer the agent's control flow. Compile-and-execute changes this boundary: untrusted data may influence values or branches inside a predefined execution graph, but it cannot redefine the user task or cause the model to synthesize new actions at runtime. translated_title: 网页智能体应采用“编译-执行”范式
translated_abstract: ReAct 已成为大语言模型（LLM）智能体的默认架构，许多现有网页智能体也遵循这一范式。我们认为，这对网页智能体而言是错误的默认选择。相反，网页智能体应默认采用“编译-执行”范式：在观察到运行时网页内容之前，先确定一个针对特定任务的程序，然后再执行它。原因在于网页内容混合了来自多方的输入。例如，一个电商产品页面可能同时包含卖家的商品信息、顾客评论、赞助广告以及平台生成的推荐内容。在 ReAct 范式下，所有这些内容在决定下一步动作时都会流入模型，从而为提示注入攻击直接操控智能体的控制流提供了途径。“编译-执行”范式改变了这一边界：不可信的数据或许会影响预定义执行图中的取值或分支，但它无法重新定义用户任务，也无法使模型在运行时合成新的动作。我们分析了 WebArena 这一流行的……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文主张网页智能体应放弃 ReAct 这一默认架构，改用“编译-执行”范式——即在观察运行时网页内容之前先确定任务程序再执行，从而防止网页中多来源的不可信内容（如提示注入）篡改智能体的控制流。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that web agents should abandon ReAct as the default architecture and adopt a compile-and-execute paradigm—committing to a task-specific program before observing runtime web content—to prevent untrusted, multi-party web content (e.g., prompt injections) from hijacking the agent's control flow.
